accessibility_and_testing.test_id_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, language triggers, theme toggles, and input fields MUST contain explicit data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid="hamburger-menu-btn", data-testid="waitlist-submit-btn", data-testid="lang-select-fr")

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow Expo React Native conventions carefully with JS files (.js).
Ensure the central logo is single-line and positioned at top-right, with hamburger menu at top-left.
Ensure language selection for English, Spanish, French is integrated inside the menu and top sections.
Ensure Theme Toggle (Dark/Light) is present in the Hamburger menu and correctly swaps root colors.
Ensure the persistent Join Waitlist CTA is visible and functional with backend API.
Keep typography and data primary, rendering the globe at the background bottom with orange scroll-driven routes.
